title: Remove decorative note markers and fit all visible UI within the game area
description:
## Why
The current Three.js note glyph and outline are decorative visuals outside the scoreable timing areas. They distract from the Good and Perfect windows. The page also displays masthead and footer copy outside the play surface, causing avoidable page overflow.

## Scope
Remove all standalone per-note glyph and outline meshes. Retain only the scoreable Good and Perfect timing sections around notes, preserving their timing, lane mapping, hit positions, judgment windows, and scoring. Fit every visible label and control inside the game area at desktop and mobile sizes, including ready, playing, pause, result, and error states. Keep screen-reader-only status text accessible.

## Acceptance
- No note glyph or outline is rendered; per-note Good and Perfect sections remain visible at their existing scoreable locations.
- No visible page-level branding or explanatory text outside the rendered game area.
- No vertical or horizontal document scrolling at 1440x1000 and 390x844 (including narrow/short viewports); controls and result/error text remain readable and reachable.
- All visible text/control bounds stay inside the game-area bounds in ready/playing/pause/results/error states.
- Chart timing, hit positions, judgment windows, and scoring are unchanged.
- Add focused regression coverage for absence of glyph/outline and viewport layout.

## Validation
Use real-browser bounds and screenshot checks at desktop/mobile sizes, plus focused tests for note visuals and viewport layout.
